# PorterChain — public website index for AI systems
# https://porterchain.com
# Navigation aid only — not a substitute for on-page content.
# Primary human chrome: Merchants (/en/business) + Drivers (/en/vehicle-partner); SEO URLs remain indexed.

## Primary hubs
- https://porterchain.com/en/ — Chooser (Merchants / Drivers)
- https://porterchain.com/en/business — Merchants hub (primary B2B capacity CTA)
- https://porterchain.com/en/vehicle-partner — Drivers / vehicle partners hub
- https://porterchain.com/en/merchants — Vanity → /en/business
- https://porterchain.com/en/drivers — Vanity → /en/vehicle-partner

## Key facts
- Same-day local delivery for businesses in the Greater Toronto Area (about 150 km around downtown Toronto; 362 postal areas / FSAs).
- Vehicles: sedan/SUV, cargo van, 16 ft box truck, all driven on a standard Ontario G licence.
- Same-day promise: order by 11 AM, delivered 2-9 PM the same day, Monday-Saturday; each quote shows the exact window.
- Pricing: per delivery from driving distance and vehicle, base distance included, HST shown; instant price at /en/delivery-cost-calculator.
- Full entity facts: https://porterchain.com/en/facts

## Same-day delivery by industry and area
- https://porterchain.com/en/delivery — Hub: 5 industries x 18 GTA areas (answer-first area guides)
- https://porterchain.com/en/delivery-cost-calculator — Instant price between two GTA postal codes (live pricing engine, HST included, no sign-up)
- https://porterchain.com/en/delivery/shopify-merchants — Shopify & e-commerce merchants (same-day rates at checkout)
- https://porterchain.com/en/delivery/pharmacy — Pharmacy & lab courier (signature, ID check, chain-of-custody times)
- https://porterchain.com/en/delivery/furniture — Furniture & appliance delivery (box truck or van, threshold delivery)
- https://porterchain.com/en/delivery/construction — Construction & trades (site materials, plumbing and electrical parts)
- https://porterchain.com/en/delivery/warehouses — Warehouses & wholesale (dock-to-dock, pallets, multi-drop)
- Pattern: https://porterchain.com/en/delivery/{industry}/{area} e.g. /en/delivery/pharmacy/mississauga
